title: Perfect Tour
text: My tour with Rod was my last day in Spain. Rod listened to my previous tours and catered a day that was perfect. He was knowledgeable (sharing a binder with old maps and pictures) and very kind. Thank you Rod. Well done!!
author: Pamela_R

title: Refreshing your through Barcelona history
text: Pablo was a refreshing guide as he guided us through Barcelona and its history.  He demonstrated not only the vertical architecture of the beautiful city but the horizontal and how it is played out.  Very good tour!
author: Clifford_E

title: Veronica is superstar
text: Veronica was the an amazing host and guide. It was raining so her quick thinking kept us dry and enjoyed our first day in Barcelona while showing us the Picasso museum!! Loved it
author: STEVEN_S

title: Excellent tour highly recommend
text: Phillippe was excellent. We learned so much in our tour today. Saw some awesome sites I highly recommend this tour not only for first time visitors but also if you have been to Barcelona before. It was such a great day and ended with a delicious glass of Sangria. Kudos to our tour guide!!!!!
author: Cheryl_B

title: Great.
text: All great, very dynamic and interesting. I went next to my crayfish and our tour was short, 100% recommended.
author: Marc G

title: Perfect introduction to Barcelona.
text: We had a wonderful day with Roberto!  He was very knowledgeable of the history of Spain and particularly Barcelona. With a charming personality and sense of enthusiasm, and a sensitivity to our preferred walking pace, we had a perfect day. HIGHLY recommended him to ou hotel concierge!
author: Barbara_R

title: Barcelona!
text: Domi was awesome!  She was patient and very informative.  I didn't even mind the 3 hours walking lol.  I would definitely look up her recommendations
author: Robneith_D

title: Excellent job
text: Had a very good time with Dominika, who oriented me very well to the city. Her knowledge of the sites was spectacular and was a pleasure to be around. Keep it up
author: Basanth_S
